name: slot-classify
description: Slot item classification pipeline — produces per-mod classification layer files.

scripts.reclassify:test-modset: bun run src/cli.ts classify-modpack modpacks/test-modset.json --out out --stages 1,2,3 --force --concurrency 8 --mod-concurrency 4
scripts.reclassify:test-modset:full: bun run src/cli.ts classify-modpack modpacks/test-modset.json --out out --stages 1,2,3 --force --concurrency 8 --mod-concurrency 4
scripts.reclassify:all: bun run reclassify:vanilla && bun run reclassify:test-modset
scripts.ship:vanilla: bun run reclassify:vanilla && bun run sync:vanilla
scripts.ship:test-modset: bun run reclassify:test-modset && bun run sync:test-modset
scripts.ship:all: bun run reclassify:all && bun run sync
